parameters.name: From
parameters.description:
The ID of the request source. Default value: **aegis**. Valid values:

*   **aegis**: Server Guard
*   **sas**: Security Center

>  If you use Server Guard, set the value to **aegis**. If you use Security Center, set the value to **sas**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-log-meta --source-ip 123.168.XX.XX --lang zh --from sas --resource-directory-account-id 1276085894170000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeLogMeta --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '123.168.XX.XX' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1276085894170000 --Lang zh --From sas
